creator.name: Nam Học AI
creator.niche: Kỹ năng AI (edit video, làm nội dung, làm việc hiệu quả) cho người Việt mới bắt đầu, chỉ từng bước bằng tiếng Việt

notes: VARIANT Hồng pastel of chia-se-meo (same layout, sizes, timing, sound): only colors/fonts differ. Overlay: source/stage-hong.html.
Origin: measured on @wipill (https://www.instagram.com/p/Dd_NUpGzqxk/), 2026-10-28, see STYLE.md. Talking-head tips format: one person, full camera, step titles + hand-drawn doodles.

Layout: FULL CAMERA the whole short (layout.keys [[0, 0]]), never split, never paper. cam.crop so the face (hair to chin) is ~24 % of the frame height (range 22 to 32), eyes at ~42 % from the top, 30 % head-room kept for the titles.

NO live word captions: captions.hide [[0, end]] in every spec. All text lives in ONE transparent HTML overlay (source/stage.html, captured --alpha, overlay scene 0 to end), like short-vid-tho-24s-mindang.

Title block, centered in the head-room: small label ('Bước 1:') Be Vietnam Pro Bold ~44 px mint #DCF7F2 with a thin dark outline at y ~300; BIG title Sigmar with font-variant small-caps (type it lower case after the first letter) ~68 px, ink #1C1C1C with a thick ~7 px mint #DCF7F2 outline, 55 to 90 % of the width, y ~395; 1 or 2 sub lines Be Vietnam Pro Bold ~44 px mint with dark outline at y ~490. Each line snaps in (one frame) on the word that says it; a new idea replaces the whole block at once.
One title block per idea of the speech (about every 3 to 6 s). Lists: a bracket header '| so sánh: ... |' then '1. ...' lines ~30 px left aligned top-left, one line per spoken item.

Floating keywords: 2 to 3 short words beside the head, ~34 px, tilted 10 to 20 deg, appearing one by one on the words. A strike: white words on the chest, then a red circle + red X over them on the negating word.
Hook (first 2 s): a small handwritten-feel context line top-left, the real logo top-right if a school/app is named, and a 3-line promise on the chest with the key words in yellow #F5E642 small caps.

Doodles: full-frame hand-drawn crayon frame (smiling sun, rainbow, clouds, daisies, butterflies, hearts, a cat line drawing, sparkles) around the person for 1 to 2 s on the happy payoff moments, about one per 30 s. Yellow hand-outlined stars (5 to 6) sprinkle around the body during a list. Draw them ourselves (SVG, wobbly 6 px strokes, pastel fills); never copy the original's memes; a meme slot = the creator's own photo or an original doodle.
Cuts: hard jump cuts only, ~2.8 s per shot, no fade. Zoom: none by default; at most ONE punch-in 1.1 on the single biggest moment, held to the next cut. zoom.drift 0.

Sound: lofi bed (assets/music/lofi-nuit.mp3) ~15 dB under the voice the whole short, from the first second, no dropouts. SFX only on payoffs: sfx.extra 'bell' when a new 'Bước N' title lands, 'pop' when a doodle frame or sticker pops, ONE assets/sfx/impact-boom.mp3 on the biggest moment. 3 to 5 sounds per short. Never whoosh, click, riser or a bloop per text line.
Grade: bright, soft, slightly desaturated pastel (original Y avg ~142/255, saturation very low); never strip red/orange from the skin, compare skin with stills/t9.5.jpg.

Fonts: Sigmar (titles) and Be Vietnam Pro Bold/ExtraBold (labels, sub lines, lists) in assets/fonts, both with Vietnamese diacritics. Never Bowlby One SC, Archivo Black, Poppins or DM Sans for Vietnamese text (no diacritics).
colors.paper = the mint outline color (#DCF7F2): the paper is never shown (full camera), it only feeds the storyboard swatch.
